kanji/上.title: 上
kanji/上.content:
上

Above, Up

On: ジョウ, ショウ, シャン
Kun: うえ, -うえ, うわ-, かみ, あ.げる, -あ.げる, あ.がる, -あ.がる, あ.がり, -あ.がり, のぼ.る, のぼ.り, のぼ.せる, のぼ.す, たてまつ.る
Kyūjitai: 丄
Componentes: ⺊, 一

Etimología
From zh sit-pro *tVŋ  top. Cognate with bo སྟེང, bo ཡང་རྩེ  summit; pinnacle (Bodman, 1980), lus zo  to be high, lus zah  to respect; to revere (STEDT).  | Shijing rimes indicate occasional level tone for pronunciation 2 (Schuessler, 2007). | Pronunciation 1 is the exopassive of pronunciation 2 with suffix *-s, literally meaning “what has been raised” (Schuessler, 2007). The rising tone in Middle Chinese words with voiced stop initials regularly evolves into departing tone in Mandarin. Pronunciation 3 results from 叶韻, i.e. its pronunciation has been artificially changed to preserve rhymes in classical poetry.

kanji/下.title: 下
kanji/下.content:
下

Below, Down, Descend, Give, Low, Inferior

On: カ, ゲ
Kun: した, しも, もと, さ.げる, さ.がる, くだ.る, くだ.り, くだ.す, -くだ.す, くだ.さる, お.ろす, お.りる
Kyūjitai: 丅
Componentes: 一, 卜

Etimología
zh :der sit-pro:*(k/g)la-k/j/t | From zh sit-pro *(k/g)la-k/j/t  to fall (STEDT): | * inside Sinitic, cognate with 落 to fall, to drop, 露 dew, 陊 to collapse and 阤 hillside, slope; | * outside Sinitic, cognate with lus tla ~ tlâk  to fall, lus thla ~ thlâk  to drop, my ကျ  to fall and my ချ  to drop. | Schuessler (2007) instead proposed an zh aav origin by comparing 下 to descend, down, below to km; additionally, he suggested that Sino-Tibetan influence had possibly caused the weakening of foreign final *-k to OC final *-ʔ. He derives the departing tone (*去聲) pronunciation via two derivations: | * 下 to be put down is an exopassive derivation (ibid.); | * 下 to descend, to fall is a later, general departing tone derivative (ibid.).

kanji/声.title: 声
kanji/声.content:
声

Voice

On: セイ, ショウ
Kun: こえ, こわ-
Kyūjitai: 声聲
Componentes: 士, 𠃜

Etimología
聲. The character itself is a p of a stone chime. See *殸.   | 聲 sv

kanji/明.title: 明
kanji/明.content:
明

Bright, Light

On: メイ, ミョウ, ミン
Kun: あ.かり, あか.るい, あか.るむ, あか.らむ, あき.らか, あ.ける, -あ.け, あ.く, あ.くる, あ.かす
Kyūjitai: 朙
Componentes: 日, 月

Etimología
Of either zh sit-pro - origin, compare | * bo མདངས  facial color, appearance, brightness (Bodman, 1980), or | * zh sit-pro *brwaŋ  loud; bright (STEDT); making it cognate with my ပြင်း  acute; violent, my ပြောင်  to shine. | Or from zh aav, cognate with 亮 (Schuessler, 2007). For more see 亮. | 盟 is a derivative (Schuessler, 2007).

kanji/期.title: 期
kanji/期.content:
期

Period, Time, Date, Term

On: キ, ゴ
Kun: —
Kyūjitai: 朞
Componentes: 其, 月

Etimología
期 stipulated time is the same word as 其 should; probably, and is cognate with 期 year (Schuessler, 2007).

kanji/減.title: 減
kanji/減.content:
減

Dwindle, Decrease, Reduce, Decline, Curtail, Get Hungry

On: ゲン
Kun: へ.る, へ.らす
Kyūjitai: 减
Componentes: 氵, 咸

Etimología
Schuessler (2007) adduces no potential cognates and leaves the origin open. That said, note strong similarities to tbq-pro *s-grum, whence my ကျုံ့.
